On 13 Apr 2018, 08:41 +0400, Farzana Jahan <apuk...@gmail.com>, wrote:
Hello,

I am running to fit a BYM model to my data using the following codes:

"
library(rgdal)
library(maptools)
library(spdep)
temp <- poly2nb(sa2_data) #creating adjacency matrix by Inla graph method
nb2INLA("sa2.graph", temp)

sa2.adj <- paste(getwd(),"sa2.graph",sep="")
H <- inla.read.graph(filename="sa2.graph")
image(inla.graph2matrix(H),xlab="",ylab="") #plotting the inla graph
formula <- y~1 + f(ID, model="bym",graph=sa2_nsw.adj,
                   scale.model=TRUE,
                   hyper=list(prec.unstruct=
                                list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001)),
                              prec.spatial=list(
                                prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001))))

#reading simulated data
liver_data<-read_csv("H:/Cancer Atlas Project/Data/SIR Results from Simulated Data.csv") #reading the full data 
liver_data<-liver_data[which(liver_data$Cancer=="Liver, Males"),]
liver_data<-liver_data[which(liver_data$Model=="Leroux"),]
y<-liver_data$Observed.counts # renaming the response 
E<-liver_data$Expected.counts #renaming the expected counts

# Preparing the Data
names <- sort(sa2_data$Sa2_name11) 
data.liver <- data.frame(y=y, E=E,Sa2_name11=liver_data$SA2) 
Nareas <- length(data.liver_nsw[,1]) # The order of the areas needs to be the same between the data and the spatial polygon object obtained importing the shapefile, so we re-order the data 

data.sa2 <- attr(sa2_data, "data") 
data.liver$ID <- seq(1,Nareas) # Include  the ID variable 1:2147 (
attr(sa2.shp, "data") <- merge(data.sa2 ,data.liver, by="Sa2_name11") #merging the shp file data and observed expected data

#fitting BYm model

model.liver<-inla(formula,family="poisson",
                  data= data.liver,E=E,
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))

"

But after I run the model, I am getting an error as:

"Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.read.graph.ascii.internal(..., size.only = size.only) :
  NAs introduced by coercion"

I would really appreciate any help or suggestions regarding solving this error.

Thanks and regards,
Farzana.
